annotations.title: Specify foam for a cushion or pad

description: Give the right foam specification for a job: density in kg/m3, hardness in newtons, depth in mm, foam type, wadding wrap, and the UK fire requirement. Use whenever someone asks what foam to buy, how thick, how firm, or why their cushions went flat. Density and hardness are different things and people constantly confuse them: density is how long it lasts, hardness is how it feels. This tool keeps them apart.

application.description: What the foam is for. Options: sofa seat, sofa back, dining seat, headboard, bench, footstool, mattress, outdoor, contract seat

width_cm.description: Optional. Cushion width, for a cut size.
